card.name: Ending nouns in common label phrases
card.fires_on: The final noun that completes a stock phrase in label instructions, such as 'sodium chloride', 'in water', 'on the floor' or 'moving car'. It also fires on the last part of 'acetone'.

modes.label: Sodium chloride
modes.description: The word chloride right after 0.9% sodium in diluent or flush instructions.

modes.label: Place or medium noun
modes.description: A concrete noun ending an instruction phrase, like water, floor or car.
modes.example: Never wash or put any part of the inhaler in<< water>>. 2.4 Dose Counter
